entities.name: Cayetana Álvarez de Toledo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cayetana Álvarez de Toledo y Peralta-Ramos, 15th Marchioness of Casa Fuerte is a Spanish journalist, historian, and politician of the People's Party. She has served as Member of the Congress of Deputies since 21 May 2019 for Barcelona and was Spokesperson of her party in Congress until 21 August 2020. She is of Spanish and French-Argentine descent.
